transcripts: the upload holds no makefun-run.json, the run record of a loose upload. For a loose upload, add one more file named makefun-run.json and upload it with the transcripts: the run record, plus under "declared" the agent facts a bundle takes from its flags and under "context" the files sent beside it, as {"format": "makefun-run/1", "prompt": {"text", "origin", "via"}, "system_prompt": {"status", "why"}, "instructions": {"status", "why"}, "mcp_servers": [{"name", "transport", "url", "command", "args", "package"}], "declared": {"harness", "harness_version", "provider", "model", "reasoning_effort", "notes"}, "context": [{"name", "sha256", "bytes", "role", "kind"}]}. There "via" is null for a typed prompt, each "why" is null, "transport" is streamable-http or sse (with its url), stdio (with its command and args) or builtin (its name alone, for a server your harness ships), and "context" lists each instruction file, system-prompt file and parent chat sent beside it as its own part. Name it makefun-run.json: a file of another name that holds a run record (its "format" is makefun-run/1) is read as the run record all the same, with a warning to rename it, and an upload carries only one. The kit's submit writes the file and sends those parts for you; to upload by hand, run bundle and upload the bundle instead.
grading is the server's, not check's: there is no local grade of this competition, the server grades every entry, and the entry's status shows its score (RULES.txt, Before you submit)
